pairing.title.description: Heading of the dialog that shows a pairing link and QR code. Same words as the button that opens it (devices.add).

pairing.body.message: Scan with a phone's camera, or open the link in another browser. If Tabsend isn't installed there yet, the link shows how to install it. It works once and expires soon.
pairing.body.description: Text under the heading of the “Add a device” dialog.

pairing.qr.label.description: Spoken description of the QR code picture in the “Add a device” dialog. Not shown on the page.

pairing.localOnly.message: This link points at {relayUrl}, which only works for another browser on this same computer. A phone or another device cannot use it. To pair those, the relay needs to be reachable on your network, and this console connected to it at that address.
pairing.localOnly.description: Yellow note under the QR code when the link only works on this computer. {relayUrl} is the web address in the link (such as http://localhost:8787).

pairing.routeNote.message: The copied link pairs browser extensions through {browserUrl}. The QR pairs phones through {phoneUrl}. Each device saves its route to this same relay; it can be changed later in its connection settings.
pairing.routeNote.description: Yellow note under the QR code when the copied link and the QR code use different addresses. {browserUrl} and {phoneUrl} are web addresses.

pairing.expires.message: Expires {when}. Make a new one if it does.
pairing.expires.description: Small note under the QR code. {when} is a date and time such as “11/3/2026, 12:15:00 PM”. “It” is the link.

pairing.error.invalidLink.message: The relay returned an invalid setup link.
pairing.error.invalidLink.description: Error at the bottom of the page when the relay's answer to “Add a device” holds a link that cannot be used.

pairing.error.invalidQrLink.message: The relay returned an invalid QR setup link.
pairing.error.invalidQrLink.description: Error at the bottom of the page when the relay's QR code link cannot be used.

pairing.error.invalidQrRoute.message: The relay returned an invalid QR pairing route.
pairing.error.invalidQrRoute.description: Error at the bottom of the page when the address inside the relay's QR code link cannot be used.

pairing.protocol.clientTooOld.message: This version of Tabsend is too old for that relay (console speaks v{clientProtocol}, relay needs v{relayRequires}). Update the console, then try again.
pairing.protocol.clientTooOld.description: Error shown when pairing, if the relay refuses this console as too old. {clientProtocol} and {relayRequires} are version numbers. A “relay” is the server that passes tabs between devices.

pairing.protocol.relayTooOld.message: That relay is running an older version of Tabsend than this console (relay speaks v{relayProtocol}, console needs v{clientRequires}). Update the relay, then try again.
pairing.protocol.relayTooOld.description: Error shown when pairing, if the relay is older than this console can work with. {relayProtocol} and {clientRequires} are version numbers.
